assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The service is documented in the clinical indication note
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on reason code CO-197
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to service delivery
Coverage cannot be applied to this specific encounter
The patient has the right to appeal this determination
